identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiation Therapy With or Without Antiandrogen Therapy in Treating Patients With Stage I or Stage II Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A PHASE III TRIAL OF THE STUDY OF ENDOCRINE THERAPY USED AS A CYTOREDUCTIVE AND CYTOSTATIC AGENT PRIOR TO RADIATION THERAPY IN GOOD PROGNOSIS LOCALLY CONFINED ADENOCARCINOMA OF THE PROSTATE

armGroups.label: Neoadjuvant TAS + RT
armGroups.description: Neoadjuvant total androgen suppression (TAS) - Flutamide and Zoladex or Lupron - two months before and during radiation therapy.

interventions.name: flutamide
interventions.description: Two 125 mg capsules (t.i.d., p.o.) beginning two months before RT and continuing until RT is completed.

interventions.name: Zoladex
interventions.description: 3.6 mg s.c. monthly x 4 beginning two months before RT and continuing until RT is completed. The 3-month preparation may be used instead of three separate monthly injections.

interventions.name: Lupron
interventions.description: 7.5 mg IM (intramuscular) monthly x 4 beginning two months before RT and continuing until RT is completed. The 3-month preparation may be used instead of three separate monthly injections.

interventions.name: radiation therapy
interventions.description: 46.8 Gy (1.8 Gy/day four to five times a week \[26 fx\]) to regional lymphatics followed by 19.8 Gy (1.8 Gy/day x 11 fx) for a total of 66.6 Gy to the prostate. Prostate only may be treated in defined circumstances.
